title: PL/I-80 Language Manual
edition_limit: Contemporary primary documentation; exact applicability to every v1.4 implementation detail is not established by the title page.

rules.paraphrase: FIXED alone declares a binary integer with precision 15. Binary storage uses signed two’s complement; precision at most 7 uses one byte, otherwise two. Decimal integer spellings become binary in a requiring context. Out-of-range binary assignment has undefined results.
Outside a binary context, decimal constants default to fixed decimal. Their spelling determines precision and scale; declared decimal variables have separate defaults.
Combining fixed binary and fixed decimal selects fixed binary as common arithmetic type.
MOD returns the common arithmetic type of its arguments. Its documented zero-divisor branch returns the first argument.
